items.name: Jan 5 — Takino Snow World: snow play & conditional tubing
items.description: Proposed January 5, 2027 for Gustavo and Camilla (2 adults) at Takino Snow World, inside Takino Suzuran Hillside National Park. Official 2026–27 winter season: December 23–March 31, 09:00–16:00. Admission plus available tubing/plastic-sled rental costs ¥0 TOTAL for two adults; transport, meals and any other paid rentals excluded. Allow 2–3 hours on site as a flexible planning estimate, not an official tour duration; allow additional return travel/waits. Namboku subway to Makomanai, then Chuo bus 真106 to Suzuran Park Higashiguchi (East Entrance); published vehicle times from Sapporo Station are about 18 minutes subway + 32 minutes bus each way, excluding waits/walking. January 2027 winter timetable/fares are not confirmed (current park timetable is summer 2026). IMPORTANT: the full 200-m tubing course usually opens late January onward; do not assume availability January 5. Check snow/open areas first; other snow play/forest walks are conditional. Tubing rope tow typically 09:15–15:30, with possible earlier queue closure. Wonderland sledding/tubing is the fallback. Keep the afternoon flexible. Beer Museum remains a desired, unscheduled option after a shorter Takino visit ONLY if return travel permits entry before 17:30 (museum closes 18:00); do not force January 5. January 3 is dinner only because expected hotel arrival is around 19:00. No booking made. Official information checked October 24, 2026. Map pin is the official broad park anchor, not the East Entrance or tubing start; use the East Entrance transit instruction above.

items.name: OPTIONAL — Clock Tower interior: Sapporo history & wooden design
items.description: Proposed OPTIONAL choice for Gustavo and Camilla (2 adults), not a reservation or confirmed time slot. PRIORITY: compact indoor cultural fallback, below the already proposed main activities. Visit the historic wooden former Sapporo Agricultural College drill hall and its small history/clock exhibits, not merely an exterior photo stop. DURATION: allow 30–45 minutes on site as a planning estimate, plus travel; official Sapporo sample itinerary uses about 30 minutes. BUDGET: ¥700 TOTAL for two adults, based on current standard admission ¥350 each; transport, shopping and meals excluded. HOURS: normally 08:45–17:10, entry until 17:00; closed January 1–3, so NOT an interior option on January 3. January 3 is DINNER ONLY: hotel arrival is expected around 19:00; no museum, exterior-photo detour or other sightseeing commitment. FIT: January 5 (Tuesday) daytime if Takino remains on hold/is skipped, or a short gap only after the Beer Museum's revised city-day placement has been protected; January 6 only if Wonderland timing leaves a genuine daytime gap. The official site gives five minutes on foot from Odori Station and ten from JR Sapporo Station, before winter walking allowance. January 4 is already a full-day excursion; do not add this then. January 7 remains conditional on departure time. PRUNE: skip the interior if time/energy is limited; an exterior photo can replace it without turning it into another commitment. Do not assume a clock-winding demonstration: January 2027 demonstration dates are unconfirmed. Recheck holiday/temporary notices before visiting. No booking made. Official sources checked October 24, 2026.

items.description: HIGH priority vegetarian-friendly counterbalance for Gustavo and Camilla (2 adults), not a fixed booking. No contact/booking. Official menu, access and venue map pin checked October 24, 2026.

items.name: Dinner OPTION — Daruma Honten jingisukan | Susukino
items.description: LOWER priority optional local-meat exception for Gustavo and Camilla (2 adults): charcoal-grilled mutton jingisukan, not a vegetarian recommendation. Choose only if both want this experience, instead of another dinner; prefer Jan 5 evening. Jan 3 hotel arrival is around 19:00: dinner only, no daytime/lunch plan, and this is a LOW-priority nearby backup only if open, the queue is short and both have energy. Small 14-seat counter, walk-in only; the official site warns of waits around 19:00–20:00. Tabletop charcoal cooking creates smoke/food smells that can cling to clothing. Allow 60–90 minutes eating plus potentially substantial queuing; avoid making it an obligatory late meal after the Jan 4 coach. Official linked food menu: basic mutton ¥1,280/plate; premium ¥1,780; fillet ¥1,680; rice ¥200–350; initial vegetables ¥320 (not free). Normal hours 17:00–05:00 next morning, last order 04:30; usual New Year closure December 31–January 2. This is not confirmation of Jan 3–7, 2027 holiday operations: recheck near travel. No availability promised, contact or booking made. Official branch/menu checked October 24, 2026; venue pin cross-checked against MapFan.
